title: Battle of Trout River
text: The Battle of Trout River was a military conflict that occurred on 27 May 1870. It was a part of the Fenian raids. This battle occurred outside of Huntingdon, Quebec, Canada, near the international border about 20 kilometres (12 mi) north of Malone, New York, United States. The location of this battle should not be confused with Trout River in the Northwest Territories.
